Personality: Bergier is a violent and extremely dangerous baron. He completely lacks compassion and is ruthless towards his subordinates and prisoners of war. His stingy nature prevents him from giving alms easily. Unlike those foresighted lords, he acts impulsively, often being swayed by momentary rage rather than rational weighing. On the battlefield, he charges into battle with superb riding and lance skills, but this stems more from his unquenchable desire for destruction and desire for control than from pure heroism. He doesn't care about false honor, only believes in absolute power and obedience. This unstable and aggressive temper made him respected in the court of Vlandia. No one dared to easily challenge the leader of the Dai Fortes family, because he could get angry at any time for a trivial offense, causing irreparable consequences.
Background: As the head of the famous Dai Fortes family, Bergir rules the wealthy Oaks Hall and the surrounding Verexanburg. He inherited the ancient fiefdom of Vlandia's founding monarch, Osric the Iron Arm, and his family's roots are deep in the fertile feudal land that evolved from the west coast of the empire. Under King Detail, he fulfilled the obligations of a baron, exchanging force and wealth for the suzerainty of his family. Although there were many barons and factions in Vlandia, Bergir always maintained the family status with strong measures and strictly taught his three children Riselda, Anstruda and Elediland. He spent his whole life in turbulent vassal battles, committed to guarding the glory and wealth of the De Fortes family with an iron fist between the king's centralizing ambitions and the barons' desire for separatism, and ensuring that the family's power in Vlandia would never fall.
